# GH Sales Lumber & Flooring

> Flooring, Japanese Sugi cedar, and good prices on quality building materials in Nampa, Idaho, serving Boise and the Treasure Valley. Select LVP and engineered hardwood in stock; MSI Prescott and MSI Cyrus by special order. 5 ft western red cedar fence boards in stock, plus carport and gazebo kits and lumber. Flooring and carpet installation available.

Pickup address: 1113 N 39th St, Nampa, ID 83687.

Products include luxury vinyl plank (LVP/SPC), waterproof laminate, hardwood and carpet; Japanese Sugi cedar; lumber and beams; fencing (including 5 ft western red cedar fence boards); decking; carport and gazebo kits; and other building materials. Limited quantities of tile, stone, and live-edge slabs are sometimes on hand. Inventory varies. Check current listings and confirm availability before making a trip.

We keep select LVP and engineered hardwood in stock and ready to pick up, with limited quantities shown in each listing. More LVP, SPC, engineered hardwood, waterproof laminate, solid hardwood and carpet lines are available by special order for the project, with matching transitions, stair nosing and trim available. Delivery is available for an added fee.

## Hours

Our hours vary, so please call or text ahead if you're making a special trip. As a small business, our hours can change, so please check our hours and call or text before you come by.

- Monday: 11 AM to 6 PM
- Tuesday: 11 AM to 6 PM
- Wednesday: 11 AM to 3 PM
- Thursday: 11 AM to 6 PM
- Friday: 11 AM to 5:30 PM
- Saturday: Closed
- Sunday: By appointment
